data.name: Pro League Golf Simulator
data.detailed_description:
The Ultimate Golf Sandbox: Your Universe Awaits

Step beyond the fairway and take command of your own professional golf universe. Pro League Golf Simulator (PLGS) is a revolutionary text-based simulation experience offering unparalleled depth and emergent storytelling. Like the legendary management sims for baseball, football, and hockey, PLGS is the deepest, most detailed golf management simulator ever created. This isn't just a game where you play golf; it's a world where you build legacies.

Whether you want to be the commissioner of a sprawling global tour, the GM of a fantasy dynasty, or the manager of a single team in a focused career, PLGS offers a mode for every type of golf fan. Manage the careers of thousands of players, watch dynasties rise and fall, and read the unique stories of every triumph and heartbreak. Your universe is waiting.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Five Unique Game Modes: Including the groundbreaking, persistent Universe Mode, a full-fledged Fantasy Dynasty Mode, and three distinct Career Modes (Stroke Play, Team Play, Combo).

  • A Living, Breathing World: A global ecosystem with over 15 professional and amateur tours, each with unique schedules and prestige. A sophisticated engine models a player's entire career arc, from their raw potential as a rookie to their peak and eventual decline.

  • Full-Fledged Fantasy Dynasty: Draft a team, manage a budget, set weekly lineups, and compete head-to-head against a league of intelligent, fully customizable AI owners in a deep fantasy league experience.

  • Dynamic Narrative Engine: The world reacts to your actions. Experience unique, procedurally generated news stories, season previews, playoff breakdowns, and off-season reports that bring your simulation to life.

  • Deep Player DNA: Every player is unique, with detailed skill ratings, hidden potential, and a dynamic career arc influenced by performance and random events. Witness promotions, relegations, and retirements for multiple reasons.

  • Comprehensive Stat Tracking: Dive into an ocean of data with detailed seasonal and career stats for every player, team, and course. Track everything from world rankings and earnings to detailed hole performance averages.

  • Complete Customization & Control: Edit any player, team, course, or tour structure. Customize the scoring systems and AI profiles to create the golf world of your dreams.

Deep Dive: Game Modes

Universe Mode: The Flagship Experience This is the ultimate golf sandbox. Take the helm of a persistent, evolving golf world that runs for decades. Manage a global ecosystem of over 15 distinct professional and amateur tours. The off-season is just as exciting as the season, featuring a fully simulated player lifecycle including Q-School, amateur graduations, tour promotions and relegations, and free agency.

Fantasy Dynasty Mode: Own the Team Experience the ultimate fantasy sports challenge. Draft a team within a tight budget, balancing superstars with undiscovered talent. Set weekly lineups or create a full-season strategy. Manage your roster through an annual rookie draft and go head-to-head against a league of intelligent AI owners, each with a unique, fully customizable strategy, and compete in a season-long schedule with a full playoff system.

Stroke Play Mode A classic individual competition. Create a league of up to 125 players and compete for points titles, earnings crowns, and the coveted Player of the Year award.

Team Play Mode A 16-team, two-division league where you manage a roster of four players. Experience a full season of head-to-head team matchups, a dramatic playoff bracket, and a detailed off-season with a rookie draft and retirements.

Combo Mode The best of both worlds. Players compete in weekly individual stroke play tournaments while their scores also contribute to their team's success in head-to-head matchups. Crown both an individual and a team champion each season.

For the Ultimate Golf Nerd

  • The Story Engine: This is more than a spreadsheet; it's a story generator. A powerful narrative engine creates unique, readable reports for every phase of your season, from detailed season previews to comprehensive off-season transaction logs.

  • Record Books & Hall of Fame: Track a massive list of single-season and all-time records for both individual and team play. Evaluate retired players against rigorous criteria for induction into the Hall of Fame.

  • Deep Stats: View comprehensive stats tables for every player and course, covering everything from basic performance to advanced metrics like par-3/4/5 scoring averages.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit), Ubuntu 20.04+, or macOS Big Sur (11.0)+
  • Processor: Dual-core processor, 2.0 GHz or higher (e.g., Intel Core i3, AMD Ryzen 3)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card that supports DirectX 11 or OpenGL 3.3. An integrated GPU (like Intel HD Graphics) is perfectly sufficient.
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), Ubuntu 22.04+, or macOS Monterey (12.0)+
  • Processor: Quad-core processor, 2.5 GHz or higher (e.g., Intel Core i5, AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: No dedicated graphics card is needed.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
